toolBindings.title: Agent tool bindings
toolBindings.description: Add or remove tools per profile: added brings in tools the profile does not list, removed drops optional ones (required tools stay)

profileSettings.title: Profile settings
profileSettings.description: The model or model role per profile, and the approval mode new sessions start with

modelRetries.title: Model request retries
modelRetries.description: How many times a failed model request is sent again; 0 turns retries off

warnCost.title: Cost warning (USD)
warnCost.description: Warns once when this session's cost reaches this amount; 0 turns it off. Models without a price are not counted

maxCost.title: Cost limit (USD)
maxCost.description: Stops sending model requests when this session's cost reaches this amount; the last request may go slightly over. 0 means no limit. Models without a price are not counted, so the limit does not apply to them

toolLoopThreshold.title: Repeated call threshold
toolLoopThreshold.description: Reminds the model after this many identical tool calls in a row, and stops the run if the results stay the same after the reminder; 0 turns it off

reliability.title: Run reliability
reliability.description: Retries for failed model requests, stall timeouts, and guards for cost and repeated calls
